usedFor: UserEcho holds customer feedback and Microsoft Excel holds your tracking sheet, so “New Comment” can run “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Topic” in UserEcho, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each new forum topic becomes a table row, a running list you can sort and review.

watchOut: “New Topic” and “New Comment” are separate triggers, so logging both needs a template for each.
